_doc: What voice_coverage.py --gate excuses: lines, cues and modules the headless pilot does not reach, each with why. An excuse for something a run reaches is reported as stale. Every excused line is still decoded from the built image by table_check.py.

modules.module 206: Konami's Telephone Game Quiz: reached by a chain of staff hotline calls over the videophone (the Q2 service gives the quiz number). Dialling the quiz's number 0990-932510 from Act 2 connects to nothing (tried, coverage run quiz_call); the numbers that lead there are the manual's. No voiced lines (no subs_206.json); pceverify checks its strings.
modules.module 158: Save handler: every Save the pilot makes (Use Metal Gear > Save, the room's own Save, the act-end prompts) loads 302 in every act. No route found that loads 158. No voiced line of its own but 86, the same record and English as 302's, which is played and read back on screen.
modules.module 270: Save handler: as 158 - no route found that loads it; its only voiced line is 86, reached under 302.
modules.module 286: Save handler: as 158 - no route found that loads it; its only voiced line is 86, reached under 302.

lines.158:86: Metal Gear's farewell under save handler 158: the module is never loaded (see module 158). The same record (act 1 NN 86) and English play under 302 in every end_* coverage run and read back on screen.
lines.334:86: Metal Gear's farewell in the factory's own bytecode: every Save there goes through 302 (end_mod334 plays it under 302). Same record and English.

lines.174:f5: Jamie answering the videophone half asleep: the game picks this or f6 ('Hello, Jamie here') by the in-game clock when Gillian calls 39-3444; a run hears one of the two (r2 heard f6, r3 f5). Calling again from the same state answers the same way.
lines.174:f6: As 174:f5: the awake answer to the same call; whichever the run's clock does not pick stays unheard.
